title: Mobile Architect
description: Role Summary Itviec’s client is seeking a highly skilled Mobile Community and Design System Lead / Architect (Android & iOS) build and lead our engineering front end community and teams. You'll architect scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions while mentoring and developing your team. You'll collaborate with other Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Designers, Solution Architect, Technical Lead, and Product Engineers to define roadmaps, drive execution, and uphold best practices. You'll contribute to the codebase and guide your team in developing innovative solutions for our customers. Responsibilities Front End Framework and Architecture Design : Ensure the design and architecture of our mobile applications is maintained and designed to meet our future growth and the needs of the developer community. Design and implement the overall architecture for our mobile applications, ensuring scalability, performance, maintainability, and security. This includes defining the technical stack, choosing appropriate frameworks and libraries, and establishing coding standards and best practices. Front End Community : Ensure all of our front end members develop their skills using a mixture of on the job learning and training. Be an advocate for the front end architecture and development approaching that you are responsible for in the wider engineering community. Global design system : Ensure that we have a platform that can give us flexibility and consistency to rapidly develop a global design system that automates this work and adopts AI techniques and tools. Our goal is to maximise efficiency whilst supporting a design that customers can love. Cross-Platform Development: Lead the development of cross-platform applications using frameworks like React Native, Flutter, or similar technologies, targeting both iOS and Android platforms. Native Development (iOS & Android): Provide expertise and guidance on native iOS and Android development when needed for platform-specific features or performance optimization. Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide mobile developers, providing technical expertise, code reviews, and fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. AI native approach. Technology Evaluation: Research and evaluate new mobile technologies, frameworks, and tools to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation. Performance Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks, optimize application speed and memory usage, and ensure a smooth and responsive user experience. Testing & Quality Assurance: Collaborate with QA teams to develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, bug-free applications. Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver solutions that meet business needs. Code Reviews: Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and best practices. Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation related to the mobile architecture, development processes, and best practices. Staying Current: Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in mobile technology and development.
requirements: Design System Experience: Developing of working within a design system at scale Extensive Native Mobile Development Experience: Proven experience of 10 years in designing, developing, and deploying mobile applications on both iOS and Android platforms, 3 years of experience at Mobile Architect or Technical Lead Cross-Platform Expertise: Strong understanding and experience with cross-platform mobile development frameworks (e.g., React Native, Flutter). Architectural Patterns: Deep understanding of mobile architectural patterns (e.g., MVVM, MVP, Clean Architecture) and their application. API Integration: Experience with RESTful APIs, web services, and cloud API technologies like API Gateways. Devops: Good understanding of mobile devops practices and expertise in tools. Cloud: Knowing the AWS cloud platform. Able to understand cloud architectures and ideate confidently Performance Optimization: Expertise in identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in mobile applications. Exposure to APM and monitoring technologies such as Datadog, Cloudwatch, Firebase etc Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban). Excellent Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues. Leadership Skills: Ability to mentor and guide other developers, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description: Role Summary As a Lead Data Engineer, you will be responsible for managing, designing, and enhancing data systems and workflows that drive key business decisions. The role is focused 75% on data engineering, involving the construction and optimization of data pipelines and architectures, and 25% on supporting data science initiatives through collaboration with data science teams for machine learning workflows and advanced analytics. You will leverage technologies like Python, Airflow, Kubernetes, and AWS to deliver high-quality data solutions. Key Activities Architect, develop, and maintain scalable data infrastructure, including data lakes, pipelines, and metadata repositories, ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of data to stakeholders. Work closely with data scientists to build and support data models, integrate data sources, and support machine learning workflows and experimentation environments. Develop and optimize large-scale, batch, and real-time data processing systems to enhance operational efficiency and meet business objectives. Leverage Python, Apache Airflow, and AWS services to automate data workflows and processes, ensuring efficient scheduling and monitoring. Utilize AWS services such as S3, Glue, EC2, and Lambda to manage data storage and compute resources, ensuring high performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency. Implement robust testing and validation procedures to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and security of data processing workflows. Stay informed of industry best practices and emerging technologies in both data engineering and data science to propose optimizations and innovative solutions.
requirements: Required Skills 12+ years of experience in total, 5+ years as a Data Engineer, hands on Python programming Core Expertise: Proficiency in Python for data processing and scripting (pandas, pyspark), workflow automation (Apache Airflow), and experience with AWS services (Glue, S3, EC2, Lambda). Containerization & Orchestration: Experience working with Kubernetes and Docker for managing containerized environments in the cloud. Data Engineering Tools: Hands-on experience with columnar and big data databases (Athena, Redshift, Vertica, Hive/Hadoop), along with version control systems like Git. Cloud Services: Strong familiarity with AWS services for cloud-based data processing and management. CI/CD Pipeline: Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, or AWS CodePipeline for continuous integration and deployment. Data Engineering Focus (75%): Expertise in building and managing robust data architectures and pipelines for large-scale data operations. Data Science Support (25%): Ability to support data science workflows, including collaboration on data preparation, feature engineering, and enabling experimentation environments. Nice-to-have requirements Langchain Experience: Familiarity with Langchain for building data applications involving natural language processing or conversational AI frameworks. Advanced Data Science Tools: Experience with AWS Sagemaker or Databricks for enabling machine learning environments. Big Data & Analytics: Familiarity with both RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, Redis) databases. BI Tools: Experience with enterprise BI tools like Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI. Messaging & Event Streaming: Familiarity with distributed messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ for event streaming. Monitoring & Logging: Experience with monitoring and log management tools such as the ELK stack or Datadog. Data Privacy and Security: Knowledge of best practices for ensuring data privacy and security, particularly in large data infrastructures.

title: An ninh thông tin (Security Engineer) - TNTech - 2V068
description: 1. Xây dựng các yêu cầu kỹ thuật về hệ thống an ninh thông tin cho tất cả các dự án công nghệ 2. Triển khai hệ thống an ninh thông tin phục vụ các dự án công nghệ. Kiểm tra, tiếp nhận các hệ thống an ninh thông tin theo các tiêu chí đã được thống nhất với người sử dụng 4. Tham gia xây dựng và triển khai ứng dụng một số quy trình, quy định, tài liệu hướng dẫn, tiêu chuẩn, các công cụ phần mềm nhằm đảm bảo việc vận hành hệ thống an ninh thông tin đáp ứng được yêu cầu hoạt động kinh doanh và tối ưu hiệu quả đầu tư (bao gồm cả các dự án tuân thủ ISO, PCI, hay các tiêu chuẩn ngành khác nếu cần) 6. Tham gia đánh giá nhu cầu sử dụng hệ thống an ninh thông tin của các đơn vị và xây dựng kế hoạch (nguồn lực, ngân sách, tiến độ, giải pháp) nâng cấp, cải thiện hệ thống hàng năm hoặc khi có yêu cầu 7. Tham gia tư vấn, triển khai hạ tầng công nghệ thông tin, mạng và an ninh thông tin cho các đơn vị và Tập đoàn, đảm bảo an ninh thông tin cho các hệ thống trong và ngoài Tập đoàn

Key Accountabilities: Data Solutioning: - Evaluate effectiveness of proposed models and track business performance against data analysis model. - Build cutting-edge algorithms and work with machine learning and deep learning tools to deliver advance analytics solutions across the firm including recommendation engines, customized data models, customer journeys, graph modes, etc. - Drive application of machine learning and big data techniques across different journeys and squads. - Manage, execute, and review complex data science projects in an agile manner and in compliance with internal regulatory requirements Data Insighting: - Lead the identification and interpretation of meaningful and actionable insights from large data and metadata sources. - Review processes and tools designed to monitor and analyze model performance and data accuracy. - Proactively lead discussions in 3+ squads to identify questions and issues for data analysis - Collaborate with Data Engineers to build complex, technical algorithms in data analytics software applications to improve work efficiency. Projects Management: - Manage project conflicts, challenges and dynamic business requirements to keep operations running at high performance. - Work with team leads to resolve people problems and project roadblocks, conduct post mortem and root cause analysis to help squads continuously improve their practices to ensure maximum productivity. MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm Chuyên gia Hạ tầng Công nghệ Thông tin có kinh nghiệm trong việc tư vấn, quy hoạch, thiết kế và triển khai hạ tầng CNTT cho các hệ thống Enterprise và Datacenter quy mô lớn. Quy hoạch và thiết kế hạ tầng Khảo sát yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và xây dựng kiến trúc tổng thể hạ tầng CNTT. Xây dựng tài liệu HLD (High Level Design), LLD (Low Level Design), BOM, HLD Review và Implementation Plan. Thiết kế các kiến trúc High Availability, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity (BCP). Triển khai và tích hợp hệ thống Triển khai và cấu hình: Máy chủ vật lý (Dell, HPE, Lenovo hoặc tương đương) Hệ thống lưu trữ SAN/NAS/All-Flash Switch Datacenter (Cisco Nexus, Arista, Juniper...) Router Enterprise Firewall (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, F5...) Load Balancer (F5 BIG-IP, NGINX...) Triển khai các nền tảng ảo hóa: VMware vSphere Microsoft Hyper-V Nutanix AHV OpenStack (lợi thế) Thiết kế và triển khai nền tảng Kubernetes: Kubernetes On-premise Red Hat OpenShift Rancher Tanzu (lợi thế) Tích hợp các giải pháp Backup, Monitoring, Logging, IAM và Automation. Quản trị và tối ưu Đánh giá hiệu năng hệ thống và đề xuất tối ưu. Xử lý sự cố mức độ phức tạp liên quan đến hạ tầng. Chuẩn hóa tài liệu kỹ thuật, quy trình vận hành và chuyển giao. Tham gia xây dựng kế hoạch triển khai, quản lý tiến độ và kiểm soát rủi ro kỹ thuật. Hỗ trợ Presales trong việc xây dựng giải pháp và thuyết trình với khách hàng khi cần.

Virtualization & Container: Làm chủ các nền tảng ảo hóa (VMware vSphere/vCenter/vSAN, Hyper-V, Nutanix) và nền tảng container (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Rancher). Hệ điều hành: Quản trị tốt Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Rocky) và Windows Server.

title: OT Security Engineer
description: The OT Security Engineer is responsible for securing the airport's operational technology — baggage handling, building management, fire-safety interfaces, physical access control, CCTV, and supporting industrial systems — from design review through commissioning and into operations. Working on the owner's team, the role reviews and challenges the designs delivered by the systems integrator and M&E contractors, verifies security evidence before acceptance, and represents OT security at the project's Architecture Review Board. The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge across ICS and building-automation systems, industrial networking, and OT security frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and CIS Controls — with proven experience in greenfield deployments, design assurance, and security acceptance in critical infrastructure environments. Working proficiency in both Vietnamese and English is required. Key Responsibilities 1. OT Security Architecture Review & Assurance Review the systems integrator's HLD/LLD network and security designs for the OT scope: zones and conduits per IEC 62443, firewall placement, and segmentation between IT, OT, and public-facing networks. Verify with L2/L3 evidence — VLAN, SVI, and routing records, management-plane and PAM design, wireless isolation proof — that no protected flow bypasses the designated firewalls. Review OT remote-access and patching paths (jump host, patch staging) to ensure no uncontrolled IT-to OT connectivity emerges. Track findings to closure through the project's decision and gap registers, distinguishing design risk from evidence gap. 2. Airport OT Systems & Safety Boundaries Own the OT security view of the airport systems: baggage handling (BHS), building management (BMS/HVAC), fire alarm (monitor-only integration), physical access control (PACS), CCTV, master clock, lifts and escalators, and power management. Defend safety boundaries: hardwired interlocks sit below the software layer and must remain independent of any network or command path. Participate in FAT/SAT/SIT and commissioning: witness command-verification, failuremode, and interlock override testing with the M&E contractors and the Commissioning Authority, and hold security acceptance criteria at each gate through ORAT. 3. Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Alignment Apply IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and CIS Controls pragmatically to an airport OT environment. Operate within Vietnam's regulatory framework for critical information infrastructure: the Law on Cybersecurity, Decree 53, and personal data protection requirements, including reporting relationships with CAAV and the Ministry of Public Security. Prepare and defend OT security positions at the Architecture Review Board; produce documentation in both English and Vietnamese for the architecture team, contractors, and authorities. 4. OT Visibility, Monitoring & SOC Integration Build and maintain a comprehensive OT asset inventory (wired, wireless, and IIoT) as the foundation for segmentation and monitoring decisions. Define requirements and acceptance criteria for passive OT network monitoring and anomaly detection, evaluating platforms capability-first: asset-discovery depth, protocol coverage, and SIEM export quality. Integrate OT telemetry into the enterprise SIEM (Splunk-based), and define alert ownership together with the SOC and the operations team. 5. Secure Procurement & Supplier Gating Write capability-based security requirements for OT procurements and assess supplier responses. Operate device compliance questionnaires as procurement gates: protocol conformance, TLS support, authenticated access, safe-state behaviour on loss of communications, and interlock independence. Define proof-of-concept scope and acceptance criteria before any monitoring or enforcement platform is purchased. 6. Wireless & IIoT Security Review wireless designs for the OT estate and verify isolation evidence for guest and public Wi-Fi against corporate and OT networks (WLC placement, SSID/VLAN separation, 802.1X, WPA3-Enterprise). Assess IIoT and telemetry radio proposals (LoRa, private 5G) as they arise, including Vietnamese spectrum constraints. 7. Emerging OT Platform Security Contribute to security review of the next-phase OT platform: Unified Namespace (MQTT/Sparkplug B, OPC UA, Kafka), IT/OT Bridge with hardware data diode, and IEC 61499 software-defined automation — including engineering and deployment-plane security, recovery and IEC 61131-3 fallback, and autonomy governance.
requirements: Qualifications & Requirements Education Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial or Control Engineering, or equivalent experience. Experience Min 3–5 years in OT/ICS security, industrial networking, or building-automation security. Experience in airports, critical infrastructure, or large campus environments strongly preferred; greenfield construction-phase experience is a significant advantage. Languages Vietnamese and English at working proficiency (required). Certifications (Preferred) ISA/IEC 62443 Expert / Practitioner, SANS GICSP, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CWSP / CWNA (for wireless OT). Technical Competencies Proficient in BACnet/IP (mandatory building-systems protocol on this project), OPC UA, and IP networking and firewalling in segmented OT environments; TLS/PKI fundamentals. Working knowledge of MQTT/Sparkplug B, Modbus TCP (legacy-exception handling), and industrial wireless security. Hands-on experience with at least one passive OT monitoring / asset-discovery platform (e.g., Forescout, Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis). Experience with enterprise SIEM (Splunk preferred), EDR in mixed IT/OT estates, and firewall review at both rulebase and architecture level. Familiarity with PLC/controller ecosystems (Schneider, Siemens, Rockwell) and exposure to IEC 61499 / IEC 61131-3 concepts. Familiar with risk management, threat modeling, and incident response for OT systems. Soft Skills Evidence-driven mindset: comfortable withholding acceptance until proof is provided, and able to state precisely what evidence would close a finding. Able to hold a security position under pressure from vendors or contractors, and to revise it when the evidence changes. Balances security rigour with operational uptime and a fixed opening date. Strong documentation habits: registers, decision records, and review comments that others can act on. Clear communication and stakeholder coordination across engineering, operations, and regulatory audiences.

The position is also accountable for executing the people leader fundamentals in line with NAB Policies, driving a learning-based culture with an ability to set and gain agreement for realistic and stretching objectives for the team. Proven ability to manage and deliver complex technology projects involving multiple engineering teams both onshore and offshore. Fluent English skills. Strong stakeholder management experience. Proven people leadership, team building, motivation, and coaching skills. Experience in managing code and change management processes. Strong ability to communicate at both strategic and operational level internally and externally, making effective decisions balancing business and stakeholder needs. Nice to have: Agile – Certified Scrum Master (preferred) Experience in the Banking or Financial Services industry; (preferred) Fluent in English communication skills (both verbal & written)

Data Integration • Strategically obtain and integrate data and information from various sources into the firm’s platforms, solutions and statistical models. • Lead discussion with Data Scientists to understand the data requirements and create re-usable data assets to enable data scientists to build and deploy machine learning models faster. • Design, build, and maintain optimized data pipelines and ETL solutions as business support tools in providing analysis and real time analytics platforms for critical decision making. • Ensure data assets are organized and stored in an efficient way so that information is high quality, reliable, flexible, and efficient. location: Quận Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội
description: Xây dựng, triển khai và vận hành hệ thống Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) nhằm đảm bảo an toàn thông tin và tuân thủ trong khối Công nghệ. Xây dựng, cập nhật và giám sát việc thực hiện các chính sách, quy trình, tiêu chuẩn và hướng dẫn về an toàn thông tin. Triển khai và duy trì các chương trình tuân thủ theo các tiêu chuẩn và framework như ISO 27001, PCI DSS (nếu áp dụng), NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP và các yêu cầu của cơ quan quản lý. Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để chuyển đổi các yêu cầu về quản trị, pháp lý và tuân thủ thành các biện pháp kiểm soát kỹ thuật phù hợp. Chuẩn bị hồ sơ, tài liệu và bằng chứng phục vụ công tác kiểm toán, đánh giá nội bộ, đánh giá bên ngoài và thanh tra. Theo dõi, đánh giá và thúc đẩy việc khắc phục các phát hiện từ Audit, Pentest và Vulnerability Assessment. Thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro bảo mật đối với đối tác, nhà cung cấp CNTT; rà soát các điều khoản bảo mật liên quan. Phối hợp xây dựng, duy trì và kiểm thử kế hoạch Business Continuity (BCP) và Disaster Recovery (DRP). Tổ chức các chương trình đào tạo, truyền thông nhằm nâng cao nhận thức về an toàn thông tin trong toàn công ty. Phối hợp với các nhóm Pháp chế, IT (Security Engineering, DevOps...), KSNB và các đơn vị liên quan để triển khai các hoạt động GRC.
requirements: Tối thiểu 03 năm kinh nghiệm trong vai trò GRC, IT Governance, IT Risk, IT Audit. Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong các tổ chức tài chính, ngân hàng, ví điện tử... Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, An toàn thông tin hoặc các chuyên ngành liên quan. Am hiểu các tiêu chuẩn và framework về an toàn thông tin như ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, OWASP . Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng chính sách, quy trình, tài liệu quản trị; thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro và theo dõi tuân thủ an toàn thông tin. Có hiểu biết về Cloud Security, Kubernetes Security, IAM (Identity & Access Management) và DevSecOps để phối hợp đánh giá, quản lý rủi ro và tuân thủ. Có kỹ năng phân tích, giải quyết vấn đề, lập tài liệu và phối hợp hiệu quả với nhiều phòng ban. Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên ngành bằng tiếng Anh.

title: Senior/Tech Lead (.NET or Nodejs)
location: Quận Tân Bình, Hồ Chí Minh
description: We are looking for a talented Senior/Tech Lead with strong .NET or Node.js foundations and solid cloud experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our web and cloud-based applications while helping the team embrace a more AI-augmented way of working. You don’t need to be an AI expert – but you should be curious, hands-on, and open to using tools like agentic coding assistants and spec-driven workflows to raise the bar on how software gets built. We value engineers who can think independently, collaborate well, and bring pragmatic judgment to both technical decisions and the evolving AI landscape. Your Role Designing, developing, and implementing software architecture solutions using either .NET or Node.js frameworks. Leading the technical design process, ensuring alignment with business goals, and translating requirements into scalable technical solutions with stakeholders. Leading the spec-driven development practices (OpenSpec, SpecKit, OpenAPI, or similar) so that requirements and API contracts are well-defined and AI-consumable before implementation begins. Encouraging the team to adopt agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot / Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Cursor, etc.) and identifying where AI can add value at each SDLC phase – from design and coding to testing and deployment. Reviewing AI-generated code and artifacts for quality, correctness, and security – applying critical judgment on hallucinations, data exposure risks, and scope drift. Providing technical leadership and mentoring to software development teams, fostering good engineering practices alongside responsible AI usage. Evaluating and recommending tools, technologies, and processes to ensure the highest quality product platform. Staying current with emerging AI tooling and industry trends, and bringing relevant advances back to the team in practical ways.
requirements: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field. At least 7 years of hands-on software development experience, with solid expertise in either .NET or Node.js (Express, Nest.js) frameworks. Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale systems from scratch, with a strong grasp of system architecture and design. Familiarity with modern architecture principles and patterns: Serverless, Domain-Driven Design, Microservices, Clean Architecture, CQRS. Some exposure to spec-driven or specification-first workflows (OpenAPI, OpenSpec, SpecKit, or equivalent) – curiosity and willingness to go deeper counts. Working familiarity with at least one agentic AI development tool (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot / Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Cursor, etc.) and an interest in expanding this across the SDLC. Practical awareness of AI limitations – hallucination, data leakage to cloud-hosted models, prompt injection, and over-reliance – and a sensible approach to mitigating them in day-to-day development. Expertise in one of the cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native architecture; cloud architecture certification is a plus. Strong experience with DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment processes. Good communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor developers and guide teams to successful outcomes.

Configure and generate RTE, integrate SWCs with BSW modules (e.g., DCM/DEM, NvM, SecOC, CSM, …). Perform ECU integration: configure BSW stacks, communication, and diagnostics. title: Lead Penetration Tester (Pentester)
description: ITviec's client is an AI-centric global digital transformation company. We design advanced data and AI transformation solutions, modernize technology architectures and develop next-generation core systems for industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing and Robotics. Partnering closely with our clients, we push boundaries to unlock their full potential. As a Lead Penetration Tester, you will be responsible for leading and performing authorized security testing activities across applications, digital platforms, APIs, infrastructure, cloud environments, and related systems. This role is designed as a hands-on technical leadership position, with approximately 70% focus on penetration testing execution and 30% focus on leading, guiding, reviewing, and coordinating security testing activities. The role focuses on identifying security vulnerabilities, validating risks, supporting remediation, and ensuring that systems meet security, regulatory, and industry requirements. You will be expected to act as a senior technical expert, providing direction on testing approach, reviewing findings, mentoring team members, and ensuring high-quality penetration testing deliverables. You will work closely with security teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, DevOps, architects, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to plan and perform penetration testing across web, mobile, API, cloud, and network environments. The role requires strong hands-on technical security skills, practical experience in ethical hacking, and the ability to communicate security risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role requires the candidate to work onsite at the client’s office based on project needs and client requirements. The onsite frequency, working schedule, location, and duration will be aligned with the client’s expectations and may vary depending on the project phase, testing activities, stakeholder meetings, security assessment timeline, and remediation support needs. Key Activities Hands-on Penetration Testing Perform authorized penetration testing for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, infrastructure, cloud environments, and digital platforms. Identify, validate, exploit where appropriate, and document security vulnerabilities, including authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, encryption, access control, and business logic issues. Conduct security assessments based on industry standards such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide, and relevant security practices. Analyze application flows, user journeys, transaction processes, access controls, and data handling mechanisms to identify potential security risks. Perform vulnerability assessment and manual verification to reduce false positives and confirm actual exploitability in authorized environments. Conduct retesting activities to validate remediation effectiveness and ensure vulnerabilities are properly resolved. Support security testing activities within the SDLC, including security requirement review, threat analysis, test planning, and release security validation. Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, security risks, and security testing best practices. Technical Leadership & Delivery Support Lead the planning, scoping, and execution of penetration testing activities across assigned projects or workstreams. Define penetration testing approach, test strategy, testing scope, priorities, timelines, and required evidence based on project and client requirements. Guide and mentor penetration testers or security engineers in testing methodology, vulnerability validation, reporting quality, and remediation discussions. Review vulnerability findings, risk ratings, evidence, and remediation recommendations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and practical value. Act as the main technical point of contact for penetration testing activities, working with client stakeholders, security teams, development teams, DevOps, infrastructure teams, and compliance teams. Facilitate vulnerability walkthroughs, risk clarification sessions, remediation discussions, and retesting alignment with relevant stakeholders. Support estimation, planning, status tracking, issue escalation, and delivery reporting for security testing activities. Contribute to improving security testing processes, reporting templates, testing checklists, knowledge sharing, and reusable testing practices. Support regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements by providing security testing evidence, reports, remediation status, and technical clarification when needed.
requirements: Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, ethical hacking, and security testing across application, API, mobile, network, and cloud environments. Proven experience leading or coordinating penetration testing activities, including test planning, execution tracking, finding review, stakeholder communication, and retesting coordination. Strong knowledge of web and API security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10, API authentication, authorization, token handling, insecure direct object references, injection, broken access control, and business logic flaws. Experience testing iOS and Android applications, including mobile application security controls, local storage, certificate pinning, authentication, session handling, and secure communication. Experience in assessing network services, servers, operating systems, misconfigurations, access controls, and common infrastructure vulnerabilities. Familiarity with cloud security concepts and security testing considerations for AWS, Azure, or GCP environments. Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nessus, Metasploit, Wireshark, Postman, MobSF, or equivalent security testing tools. Ability to independently validate vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, determine business impact, and provide clear remediation recommendations. Ability to write and review clear security reports, including vulnerability details, risk ratings, technical evidence, business impact, and remediation guidance. Ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear, structured, and practical manner. Ability to work with engineering teams to clarify root causes, support fix implementation, and perform retesting. Good understanding of secure coding principles, data privacy, encryption, identity and access management, and common security frameworks. Understanding of security requirements in regulated, audit, or compliance-driven environments. Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple testing activities in parallel. Excellent English communication skills are required, with the ability to communicate fluently and confidently with client stakeholders, security teams, business users, and technical teams. Nice-to-have Requirements Prior experience working on penetration testing or security assessment projects for banks, fintechs, payment platforms, card systems, or financial institutions. Good understanding of banking systems, digital banking, payments, cards, customer onboarding, AML/KYC, fraud management, account services, and transaction flows. Familiarity with banking security practices and financial industry security requirements. Familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SWIFT Customer Security Controls Framework, local banking regulations, or other financial industry security requirements. Experience conducting secure code review or working with SAST tools to identify security issues in application code. Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with tools such as SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, or secrets detection. Familiarity with cloud misconfiguration assessment, container security, Kubernetes security, Docker security, and infrastructure-as-code security checks. Experience with controlled red team exercises, attack simulation, phishing simulation, or adversary emulation in authorized environments. Ability to use Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages to automate testing, validation, or reporting tasks. Experience building security testing methodology, playbooks, checklists, report templates, or quality review practices. Experience mentoring junior or mid-level penetration testers and supporting capability development within a security testing team. Relevant certifications such as CEH, eJPT, PNPT, OSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are preferred.

title: Lead Security Engineer (Python)

Vai trò này đòi hỏi sự kết hợp giữa tư duy kiến trúc hệ thống, năng lực kỹ thuật chuyên sâu và khả năng đồng kiến tạo (co-create) cùng các đội ngũ Phát triển Sản phẩm (Engineering/Product) nhằm thực thi nguyên tắc Security-by-Design trong toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển. I: Trách nhiệm & Phạm vi Ảnh hưởng 1. Kiến trúc An ninh Sản phẩm (Product Security & Architecture) Chủ trì thực hiện Security Architecture Review và Threat Modeling cho các hệ thống và dịch vụ trọng yếu của hệ sinh thái. Định hình các phương án thiết kế bảo mật tối ưu, đảm bảo sự cân bằng giữa tính an toàn, trải nghiệm người dùng và tốc độ vận hành kinh doanh. Trực tiếp đánh giá chuyên sâu an ninh ứng dụng (API, Mobile, Web, Backend) và các nền tảng Platform cốt lõi. 2. Vận hành An ninh Ứng dụng & DevSecOps Thiết lập và chuẩn hoá khung làm việc Secure SDLC / DevSecOps trên quy mô toàn tập đoàn. Tự động hoá quy trình kiểm soát an ninh (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC Scanning, SBOM) vào hệ thống CI/CD. Điều phối các hoạt động rà soát mã nguồn (Secure Code Review), Pentest. Quản trị rủi ro và ưu tiên xử lý lỗ hổng dựa trên phân tích tác động thực tế tới doanh nghiệp. 3. An ninh Hạ tầng Cloud & Platform Thiết kế và rà soát các chốt chặn an ninh trên Cloud (GCP/AWS), hướng tới quản trị Multi-cloud bền vững. Tư vấn triển khai chuyên sâu về IAM Hardening, Network Security, Workload Isolation và Data Protection. Đảm bảo an ninh cho môi trường Kubernetes, Container Platform và hạ tầng mã hoá (IaC). 4. Quản trị Rủi ro, Tuân thủ & Công nghệ Mới Đảm bảo an ninh dữ liệu và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2). Nghiên cứu và đánh giá rủi ro cho các công nghệ tiên phong: AI/ML Security, Blockchain, Automation. Dẫn dắt các hoạt động Security Research, chia sẻ tri thức và xây dựng cộng đồng bảo mật nội bộ. 5. Dẫn dắt & Phát triển Năng lực (Leadership & Enablement) Cố vấn (Mentor) và phát triển chuyên môn cho các thành viên trong đội ngũ Security. Xây dựng hệ thống Playbook, Security Patterns và hướng dẫn lập trình an toàn (Secure Coding Practices). Thúc đẩy văn hoá an ninh thông tin xuyên suốt các đơn vị kinh doanh và khối kỹ thuật.
requirements: II: Yêu cầu Năng lực 1: Tiêu chuẩn Bắt buộc (Must-have) Tối thiểu 6 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên sâu trong lĩnh vực Security Engineering / Product Security / Cloud Security. Có ít nhất 3 năm đảm nhiệm vai trò Lead, Expert hoặc Senior IC với khả năng dẫn dắt kỹ thuật độc lập. Am hiểu sâu sắc về Threat Modeling, Secure Design Review và Vulnerability Management. Kinh nghiệm thực chiến về Cloud Security (GCP/AWS), Kubernetes và DevSecOps Automation. Kỹ năng giao tiếp chiến lược, có khả năng thuyết phục và làm việc hiệu quả với các Stakeholders cấp cao. 2: Lợi thế Ưu tiên (Nice-to-have) Chứng chỉ quốc tế uy tín: CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, eMAPT, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer. Kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực Fintech, E-commerce hoặc các hệ sinh thái số (Digital Ecosystems). Kinh nghiệm về AI Security, LLM Security hoặc Privacy Engineering.

title: Security Specialist (EDR, IAM, Networking)
description: Why We Are Hiring We are hiring one Security Specialist to strengthen and grow the Corporate Security & Governance function at MFV. This person will: Take over and run the routine corporate security and governance operations currently handled by the Money Forward Japan (MFJ) side, and operate them locally at MFV. Gradually build up expertise and, over time, take ownership of security incident handling, focused primarily on MFV. Work alongside the existing security members to drive security improvements at MFV, collaborating on security education and training tailored to MFV’s current situation. About the CISO Office With the mission “Maximize the value we deliver to customers through security,” the CISO Office defines how security should work across the entire Money Forward group. Keeping services running and preventing information leaks matter deeply—but they are only part of what we care about. Excessive security controls can slow development and reduce or delay the value we deliver to customers. As security professionals, we constantly weigh risk and design the security that is genuinely optimal for our customers. Our security principles Embedded security in business strategy — Security is never considered in isolation. We design security measures together with the business strategy: the current business phase, cost, expected future revenue scale, and the potential losses if a risk materializes. Advanced balancing between security and experience — The strongest possible security is not always the right answer, as it raises cost and can harm usability. We assess risk and choose the optimal measures—sometimes taking on risk to pursue maximum user value—and drive automation to reconcile usability and security at a high level. Autonomous and scalable security organization — As the group’s development organization grows, a CISO Office that owns every security function would become a bottleneck. Each development team must be able to build secure services autonomously, and the CISO Office builds the mechanisms and support that make this possible. What You Will Do Drawing on your knowledge and experience in information security, coding, and infrastructure, you will maintain and improve Money Forward’s security in close collaboration with the Global IT department and the CISO Office. Your responsibilities include: Work closely with and report to the CISO Office in Japan on corporate security and security governance, ensuring effective cross-border collaboration—and, through this, contribute to group-wide (global) security matters. Take over routine corporate security and governance operations from the MFJ side and run them locally at MFV. Operate and manage security tooling such as EDR, SWG/DLP, and MDM. Perform security risk management for internal systems and external SaaS usage. Build controls that comply with security guidelines and governance requirements. Respond to security incidents for internal systems, progressively taking ownership of incident handling at MFV. Plan and drive device security measures. Implement and roll out frameworks such as NIST CSF and CIS Benchmarks. Gather information on and validate new technologies from major vendors (e.g., Microsoft). Collaborate with the existing to design and deliver security education and training suited to MFV’s situation.
requirements: Required Skills & Experience Solid foundational understanding of computer science, including networking, operating systems, data structures, and cryptography. Development experience in at least one programming language. Hands-on experience building and operating internal systems (e.g., MDM, EDR, Entra ID). Experience building and operating security appliances (Firewall, IDS/IPS, etc.) and network equipment. Business-level English for professional communication with the Japan-based team and for documentation. Preferred Skills & Experience Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or GCIH. Deep understanding of authentication and authorization, OIDC, and OAuth. Experience with security-related work in the finance / fintech industry (e.g., FISC and similar standards). Experience developing AI, or developing with the help of AI tools. (As shared in Money Forward AI Vision 2025, Money Forward is actively using AI to improve operational efficiency and expects to introduce AI agents across all products in the future.)

title: 2D Game Artist
description: As a 2D Game Artist, you will be responsible for creating high-quality visual assets that bring our fantasy adventure games to life. title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS)
description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer with a strong background in AWS infrastructure design, deployment, and operations . Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash ). Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK . Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently with high ownership and accountability. Excellent communication and documentation skills in English. Nice to Have AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional , DevOps Engineer , or SysOps Administrator ). Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry). Knowledge of CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI). Exposure to cost optimization, tagging strategies, or FinOps practices.

This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about cloud-native infrastructure, database performance, automation, and modern data platforms. Architect, provision, and manage PostgreSQL databases on AWS Aurora for mission-critical production systems. Implement and maintain PostgreSQL Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), managing roles, grants, schema privileges, and least-privilege access across production and multi-tenant environments. Collaborate with Software Engineers and Platform teams to design scalable and reliable data architectures for SaaS products. Establish database standards, governance, security policies, backup strategies, and operational best practices across engineering teams. Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term improvements to platform reliability. Lead database upgrades, migrations, and platform modernization initiatives with minimal service disruption.
requirements: Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in Database Engineering, Database Administration, Platform Engineering, or Backend Engineering with strong database expertise. Experience managing cloud-native database services, preferably AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS. Strong SQL skills with the ability to optimize complex, high-volume production workloads. Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to provision and manage database infrastructure. Strong experience with PostgreSQL Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), including managing roles, grants, schema privileges, and applying least-privilege principles across production and multi-tenant environments. Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems and cloud infrastructure. Experience working in modern CI/CD, DevOps, and Platform Engineering environments. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and system design skills. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience building automation tools and operational scripts using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages. Experience with PostgreSQL extensions such as pgvector , PostGIS , or TimescaleDB . Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized environments. Experience with data warehousing technologies such as Amazon Redshift. AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform, or Kubernetes certifications. Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities.

title: Business Analyst (English)
description: Full-time Business Analyst who bridges the CTO , Tech Lead , and engineering team for the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP). You own product backlog quality in English —user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes, and sprint-ready specs—while helping the team navigate Dutch domain context from advisors and the outgoing builder. Current engineering phase (May 2026) Production runs on a live WordPress plugin with paying tenants. Engineering follows a strangler-fig path toward Next.js (web) , Flutter (mobile) , and Python/FastAPI services. Your specs must reflect what exists today , what is being completed , and what is net-new —without assuming a greenfield-only product. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) — a voice-first, multilingual platform that connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Work directly with the CTO (Mark Koops) and Tech Lead to clarify scope, priorities, and trade-offs; capture decisions in writing. Maintain the product backlog in Jira or Linear : epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and definition of done in English . Support sprint planning and refinement: ready stories for Middle Fullstack, juniors, UX, and Data Scientist; flag dependencies and risks early. Translate inputs from Dutch stakeholders (outgoing builder, legal/compliance advisors, tenant feedback) into clear English requirements for the HCMC engineering team. Document Phase 1 MVP and Arne product backlog items (e.g. retargeting, widget orders, Stripe, AI prompt UX, vendor matching) with testable acceptance criteria aligned to the engineering plan. Write release notes and internal summaries for tenant-facing changes when features ship. Partner with UX Designer on flows, edge cases, and copy (including “AI estimate” and compliance-sensitive wording). Support hiring and onboarding : review role priorities, help define interview scenarios, and maintain a single source of truth for “what we are building this quarter.” Track open questions for the CTO (budget, legal, beta cohorts, feature phasing) and ensure they are closed or explicitly accepted as risk.
requirements: Fluent English (mandatory) — written and spoken; you will join calls with the Dutch CTO and produce all specs in English. 3+ years as Business Analyst, Product Owner, or similar in B2B SaaS or marketplace products. Strong user story and acceptance criteria writing; comfortable with technical teams (APIs, web/mobile, AI features at a conceptual level). Experience with Jira, Linear , or equivalent; basic understanding of agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint review). Ability to structure ambiguous requests into prioritized, testable work items. Professional, calm communication in a small, fast-moving startup. Nice to have Ability to read Dutch (documents, emails, UI labels) even if specs are written in English. Exposure to real estate , proptech, or marketplaces (vendors, subscriptions, commissions). Familiarity with GDPR or EU product constraints at a requirements level (with legal advisor review). Basic understanding of WordPress , REST APIs , or Flutter/mobile lifecycles (not required to code). Experience working with distributed teams (Europe + Vietnam time zones).

title: Data Scientist (AI & Real Estate Valuation)
description: Role summary Data scientist who owns the development, validation, and ongoing improvement of AI prediction models for current and future real estate valuations in the Netherlands. You strengthen the intelligence layer behind the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its resellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — turning Dutch property data (and realtor-uploaded history) into trustworthy valuations and forecasts for realtors, vendors, and clients. Current engineering phase Production valuations today use the Altum AI API integrated in the live WordPress plugin. Your models will augment and eventually replace that dependency over time — not on day one. Early months focus on data audit, Excel ingest design, baselines, and experimentation ; heavier ETL (Airflow) and production ML serving ramp in the second half of the 6-month plan. Target accuracy: MAPE < 6–8% on hold-out data where feasible. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) — a voice-first, multilingual platform that connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully resellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Collect, explore, clean, and preprocess data from Dutch sources ( CBS, Kadaster, BAG, PDOK , ECB/OECD macros, and realtor Excel uploads ) to build robust training and validation datasets. Funda/Pararius ingestion only where legally approved (may be deferred for MVP). Perform feature engineering , including geospatial work (e.g. geopy/geopandas), temporal lags, economic adjustments (interest rates, inflation), and Dutch-specific factors ( energy labels , postcode granularity, house age, WOZ influence). Design, train, and iterate on ML models for property valuation ( XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM ) and, where scoped, time-series forecasting ( LSTM, Prophet , or hybrid approaches) targeting MAPE < 6–8% on hold-out and realistic test sets. Benchmark against the existing Altum integration so we can switch or A/B without regressing tenant-facing quality. Conduct rigorous evaluation : cross-validation, backtesting against historical Dutch market shifts, and monitoring for concept drift (e.g. post-2022 rate changes, energy transition). Apply explainability ( SHAP, LIME ) so product and voice flows can surface understandable drivers (e.g. location, energy label contributions). Integrate models into the Python backend (FastAPI) for batch and real-time inference, working with the Middle Fullstack Developer and Junior Backend Developer on reliable, low-latency serving. Automate retraining pipelines ( Cloud Composer / Airflow ) and contribute to the ETL layer so models receive fresh data. Analyze errors, market trends, and feedback; propose improvements (e.g. renovation scenarios, risk flags, personalized insights). Document models, experiments, feature importance, and data usage for GDPR , internal knowledge sharing, and future white-label use. Partner with the Tech Lead on model selection, architecture, and scalability; support data-science best practices across the team as it grows.
requirements: Required skills & experience 2–4 years professional experience as a Data Scientist or ML Engineer with at least one model used in production or serious pilot ; 3+ years welcome for stronger candidates. Strong Python for data science ( pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM ; TensorFlow/PyTorch or statsmodels as needed). Solid experience with regression and preferably time-series forecasting ; geospatial skills (geopandas, geopy) a significant plus. Proven ability to clean and merge large, messy datasets, handle outliers, and engineer features that improve accuracy. Practical knowledge of MAPE, RMSE, MAE , hyperparameter tuning ( Optuna , GridSearch), cross-validation, and explainable AI ( SHAP, LIME ). Comfortable with SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and Git . Strong analytical mindset; ability to translate real estate and business problems into data-driven solutions. Eagerness to work in a small startup, iterate quickly, and take ownership of outcomes. Good English for documentation and collaboration with the CTO and Tech Lead. Nice to have Dutch real estate domain knowledge (energy labels, WOZ, regional trends, post-2020 market shifts). Experience deploying ML (Docker, FastAPI, Cloud Run , drift monitoring). Airflow / Cloud Composer or data quality tools ( Great Expectations ). MLflow or similar experiment tracking. Multimodal or LLM-enhanced features (images, RAG) — if scoped later. Dutch language for reading source documentation.

title: Test Automation Engineer

title: AI Engineer (AI ML/CV/OCR, Yolo, Python, Pytorch)
location: Quận Tân Bình, Hồ Chí Minh
description: YOU You want to be an important member of a strong team of other makers who take pride in their work and support each other. As a Senior AI Engineer , you will join the AI-Powered Takeoff Team in Vietnam, collaborating closely with U.S. stakeholders and coordinating with external vendors to build an AI-driven product that transforms technical drawings (PDFs, CAD files, and blueprints) into actionable data, directly improving product performance and business efficiency. title: Senior IT Security Solution Officer
description: 1. Job Purpose: Ensure that approved IT security policies, rules and/or configurations are implemented across MB Life IT security systems and its Infrastructure. Ensure that all security and/or monitoring software, computers, firewalls, servers, devices, appliances, and related IT infrastructure are up to date and configured based on existing MB Life corporate security rules, standard policies and procedures. Understand the security context and operational specifics of the BFSI industry, especially the integration and security protection of the core insurance system. Ensure effective implementation of IT security practices within cloud environments (AWS, O365…). This role requires experience in the application of AI in cybersecurity operations such as threat detection, anomaly analysis, system monitoring, and automation. 2. Key Responsibilities: Ensures appropriate MB Life systems and/or devices are properly configured, updated and working appropriately to detect potential threats and security incidents. Overseas and monitors the system security operations (cyber and internal) such as user account management, network vulnerability scanning, virus database update/scanning and other security measures (detailed below) are performed in accordance with existing MB Life standard policies and procedures. Detection of anomalies, cyber threats and fraudulent use of computers and computer systems. Security electronic communication (email and social media); Protection of personal data and privacy. Secure IT development with regards to MB Life business applications Data masking, encryption, security testing, certification, digital signatures and Public Key Infrastructure Provides support, education and training for all employees in terms of IT Security risk awareness within the organization. Performs audits, reviews, analyses and report submission of security log files as described in approved IT security policies. Participates in the review of investigations after breaches or incidents, including impact analysis and recommendations for avoiding similar vulnerabilities. Provides technical support, education and training to all employees in terms of IT Security risk awareness within the organization. Provides technical support and/or recommendation on IT security technology that would help align MB Life with the latest technology and industry standards.
requirements: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security or a related technical field. At least 3 years solid IT experience with actual hands-on experience in IT Security operations and monitoring using top of the line technology solutions. Practical experience or familiarity with security operations in the BFSI sector, especially life insurance sector is a significant advantage. Proven experience managing cybersecurity in cloud-based infrastructures (especially AWS, O365…). Experience or involvement in AI-based applications in cybersecurity, including automated threat detection, anomaly detection, or log analysis.

title: Senior Manager, Business Ownership (Product & Growth)
description: MoMo is looking for a business owner who can take a product vertical and run it end-to-end — strategy, product, and growth — not just manage a workstream inside it. You build and ship the product, and you own the metrics that prove it's working. This is structured as a track toward full business ownership: managers who deliver against the product and growth mandate progress toward owning a wider vertical or business unit, with P&L-level scope and visibility. We're not looking for someone to run a single function well. We're looking for someone who can be hands-on in product and rigorous enough to own a number. Key Responsibilities: Business Ownership Own the vertical's growth and business targets (e.g. MAU, GMV, revenue, or other core metrics). Take end-to-end accountability for outcomes — not just delivery of tasks or features. Product Leadership Define and own the product roadmap for the vertical, aligned to business goals and user needs. Drive product discovery, feature prioritization based on user research, data, and competitive insight. Stay hands-on through the build cycle — working with Product from spec to launch, not handing off after requirements. Growth & Performance Define the KPIs that matter, diagnose funnel or performance issues, and design experiments (A/B testing, cohort analysis) to improve activation, retention, or conversion. Use data and analytics to make growth levers (incentives, product changes, channel mix) work together rather than in isolation. Cross-functional & Team Leadership Build and develop a team, with clear growth paths for each member. Lead and influence stakeholders across Tech, Risk, Legal, Marketing, Finance, and other functions — through influence, not just reporting lines. Represent the business in cross-functional and leadership-level working groups.
requirements: Must have 8+ years of experience in Product, Growth, or a Business/GM role within a complex, cross-functional environment. Direct ownership of at least one business or product metric (e.g. activation, retention, GMV, revenue), with concrete, presentable results — ideally including P&L or P&L-adjacent ownership. Experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, or platform/marketplace businesses. Exposure to data-driven growth techniques (segmentation, experimentation, A/B testing at scale). What Makes This Role Different: Most product roles optimize a roadmap. Most growth roles optimize a funnel. This role is for someone who doesn't want to pick one — who can be hands-on in shipping product and still be the person who owns whether the number moves, and who's ultimately measured on the health of the business, not just the workstream.

title: Junior Backend Developer (Python / APIs)
description: Entry-level backend developer who will help build and maintain the Python-based services powering the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its re-sellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP). You will work closely with the Tech Lead and Middle Fullstack Developer (WordPress + Python) to implement FastAPI endpoints, support Grok Voice Agent integration, work with Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL) , external data sources, Stripe payments, and other integrations — under guidance from senior engineers in a fast-moving startup environment. Current engineering phase (May 2026) Production business logic and many APIs still run on the WordPress plugin (/wp-json/qr/v3). New Python services are added using a strangler-fig approach: no big-bang rewrite . Your work often extends or bridges existing behaviour while we build FastAPI services (CCI, voice proxy, ETL helpers). Web clients use React/Next.js ; mobile uses Flutter — you integrate with both via APIs, not only a greenfield backend. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) — a voice-first, multilingual platform that connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Implement and maintain clean REST API endpoints using FastAPI (or Flask where appropriate) based on specifications and OpenAPI docs from the Tech Lead. Support strangler migration : respect backward compatibility for WordPress REST where features still live in PHP; add or extend /api/v1/* Python routes without breaking live tenants. Integrate external APIs and real-time services — including Grok Voice Agent WebSocket proxying (under supervision), Stripe Connect webhooks and payment flows, and third-party data sources ( CBS, Kadaster, PDOK , etc.) — using Python HTTP clients and SDKs. Write and maintain simple, efficient database queries ( PostgreSQL via Cloud SQL) and schema migrations under supervision. Assist with logging, monitoring , error handling, and observability ( Cloud Logging, Sentry ). Write unit and integration tests ; help document APIs, internal services, and tool functions callable by Grok . Participate actively in code reviews , follow team standards ( ruff/black, mypy, pre-commit where adopted), and learn modern Python backend patterns. Collaborate with Middle Fullstack , Junior WordPress/PHP , UX , and Data Scientist (part-time) to ensure smooth end-to-end flows (voice → API → database → response).
requirements: 1–2 years of backend development experience (internships, freelance projects, personal/open-source work, or strong portfolio are fully acceptable). Solid Python fundamentals (functions, modules, virtual environments, packaging, async/await basics). Basic experience building HTTP APIs (REST/JSON) and working with external services via requests , httpx , or SDKs. Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, simple joins, indexes) and relational databases. Familiarity with Git (branching, pull requests, commit hygiene) and collaborative workflows. Strong willingness to learn quickly, accept constructive feedback, and thrive in a small, supportive team. Good English communication skills (written & spoken) for team discussions, documentation, and reading technical resources. Nice to have Exposure to FastAPI (preferred), Flask, or Django. Experience with real-time features (WebSockets, LiveKit) or AI/ML API integrations (e.g. Grok, OpenAI, Anthropic). Basic knowledge of PostgreSQL , SQLAlchemy , or async drivers ( asyncpg ). Familiarity with Docker , containerized development, or Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions). Understanding of RESTful design , OpenAPI/Swagger , or basic API security ( JWT , rate limiting). Basic awareness of WordPress REST or PHP (you do not own the plugin, but you may consume or align with its API contracts). Interest in voice AI , marketplaces, or real estate tech.

title: QA Engineer (Tester/ QA QC)
description: As a QAE, you will help to ensure that the product systematically meets and exceeds our users’ expectations. You will contribute by designing & executing the most efficient manual testing strategy to ensure that: 90+% of defects are identified & documented before reaching the end-users Exclusive of defects that can only be detected in the client environment All features behave as they should (i.e no regression) For all the releases supported All new features are evaluated from an End User perspective Understand users and create relevant testing scenarios Proactively suggest improvements for our product and methodologies Report what does not work well or is broken, even if not part of the current assignments

Strong self-discipline for delivering well-tested, complete features/modules under a tight schedule and the capability for rational thinking. Nice to have: Experience in accessibility testing (familiarity with WCAG, accessibility shortcuts, keystrokes; WAS certification) is a plus, but not mandatory. Experience in test automation with knowledge of automation frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Selenium) and scripting languages (e.g., TypeScript, Java, JavaScript, C#).

title: [Danang] Project Leader/ PMO/ BrSE (Japanese N2+)
location: Quận Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
description: We are looking for an experienced Project Leader (PMO) to support project governance, delivery monitoring, and quality assessment for software development projects serving Japanese customers. The role focuses on reviewing project information, analyzing delivery status and quality indicators, identifying potential risks and areas for improvement, and providing objective observations and recommendations to both customers and offshore teams. The position supports project transparency, quality improvement, and delivery governance through continuous monitoring and data-driven analysis. Project Monitoring & Analysis Review project progress, delivery status, quality metrics, and project documentation to obtain an objective view of project health. Analyze project data, reports, schedules, defect trends, issue logs, and other project indicators to identify potential risks, quality concerns, or process gaps. Monitor compliance with agreed project processes, quality standards, and customer requirements. Evaluate project execution from governance and quality perspectives and provide independent observations to stakeholders. Quality & Governance Support Identify delivery risks, quality issues, process weaknesses, and operational challenges that may impact project outcomes. Raise observations, concerns, and improvement recommendations based on project data and evidence. Provide insights and suggestions to offshore teams and customers on improving project quality, risk management, development processes, and delivery transparency. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, lessons learned, and best practices across projects. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication Consolidate and analyze information from multiple project sources to prepare project monitoring reports and governance summaries. Provide objective updates regarding project status, quality trends, risk indicators, and areas requiring management attention. Present findings, observations, and recommendations to project stakeholders in a clear and professional manner. Maintain project governance records, assessments, monitoring reports, and related documentation. Other Responsibilities Support Manager / Senior Manager in governance, quality assurance, and project monitoring activities. Perform other tasks assigned by Manager / Senior Manager.
requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 3+ years of experience in software development, holding the role as QA/QC/ PMO/ Team Leader / Project Leader / Project Manager for Japanese projects. Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), project governance, software quality management, and delivery processes. Experience analyzing project status, delivery quality, project risks, and development metrics. Familiarity with Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience working with Japanese customers in offshore development environments. Proficiency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or above). Experience in web-based systems using Java (Spring), Angular. Banking domain knowledge is a plus. PMP, ACP, ISTQB, or equivalent certifications are advantageous. Strong leadership, client-facing, presentation, and negotiation skills. Willingness to travel or work overseas when required.

Define the testing objectives and criteria for success and oversee the testing and follow up processes for software products. Determine requirements and develop test plans. title: Backend Engineer (Grok Voice Agent)
description: Role summary Senior-leaning backend engineer who owns the real-time voice layer behind the Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM) and its re-sellable AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP). You build and operate the Grok Voice Agent integration — the WebSocket proxy, the tool-calling framework that lets our agent "Q" execute real platform actions (valuations, CRM, vendor matching, workflow state changes, payments), and the text/chat fallback. This is the single most central engineering role in our AI-native vision: voice is the primary interface, not a feature. You work closely with the Tech Lead and the Middle Fullstack Developer, and you set the patterns the Junior Backend Developer and Junior Flutter Developer follow when they consume your APIs. Current engineering phase (May–July 2026) Production today runs on a WordPress plugin with REST /wp-json/qr/v3 and paying Dutch realtor tenants. New Python/FastAPI services are added alongside using a strangler-fig approach — no big-bang rewrite. The voice track is net-new : you build the FastAPI voice proxy and tool endpoints from the ground up, while respecting the existing API contracts and multi-tenant model ( organization_id , roles/capabilities). Web clients use React/Next.js; mobile uses Flutter (LiveKit on the device) — both consume your real-time layer via APIs. About Quality Realty (QR) Quality Realty is an early-stage AI-native SaaS startup building the future of real estate transactions in the Netherlands. We are developing Quality Realty Marketplace (QRM). This voice-first, multilingual platform connects realtors, clients, and service vendors (painters, movers, stagers, energy auditors, etc.) throughout the entire home buying, selling, and rental process. At its core is the AI Native Marketplace Platform (ANMP) — a fully re-sellable, white-label, multi-tenant marketplace operating system. QR is the first vertical (Dutch real estate), designed from day one to power other local-service marketplaces worldwide. Key responsibilities Build and maintain the Grok Voice Agent WebSocket proxy in Python/FastAPI: low-latency, streaming, reconnect-safe, with LiveKit integration points for the Flutter mobile client. Design a clean, versioned "tools" API that the voice agent can call to execute real actions — CRM operations, vendor matching, property valuations, workflow/order state changes, and payment flows — with strict input validation and per-tenant authorization on every call. Implement authentication and session management for voice sessions: JWT-based auth middleware, tenant context propagation ( organization_id , roles), session lifecycle, and a robust text/chat fallback for when voice is unavailable. Productionize the first 8–10 core voice commands mapping to real realtor actions, end-to-end (intent → tool call → backend mutation → spoken/visual confirmation). Integrate external AI/LLM and real-time services (Grok primary; Anthropic/OpenAI where relevant) and coordinate with the Middle Fullstack Developer on WP-side tool endpoints during transition. Handle observability and reliability : structured logging, tracing on the streaming path, error handling, idempotency, and graceful degradation (Cloud Logging, Sentry). Write OpenAPI specs, tool-function docs, and developer handoff notes so the Junior Backend, Junior Flutter, and Next.js engineers can consume and extend the voice layer safely. Enforce security and privacy on the voice path: no PII in logs/metadata where avoidable, GDPR-aware transcript handling, access control on sensitive tools (payments, payouts). Participate in code reviews, follow team standards (ruff/black, mypy, pre-commit where adopted), and partner with the Tech Lead on architecture and scalability
requirements: Required skills & experience 3–5 years of backend engineering , with proven delivery of production services. Strong Python (FastAPI preferred; async/await, packaging, testing) — required. Hands-on real-time systems experience : WebSockets, streaming, low-latency APIs, connection lifecycle, and backpressure handling. Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs (Grok, Anthropic, OpenAI) or voice platforms (LiveKit, Twilio, Vonage, or similar). Solid understanding of authentication and session state (JWT/OAuth, secure token handling) and cloud deployment concepts (containers, serverless; GCP a plus). Comfortable designing and documenting JSON/REST APIs and OpenAPI specs. Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and safe schema/migration practices under supervision of the Tech Lead. Good English communication (written and spoken) for documentation, team discussions, and collaboration with the Dutch CTO and Tech Lead. Nice to have Experience building tool-calling / function-calling frameworks for LLM agents. Familiarity with LiveKit , WebRTC, or audio streaming pipelines. Điều phối dự án & xử lý vấn đề ● Tiếp nhận định hướng, mục tiêu từ cấp quản lý và chuyển hóa thành kế hoạch hành động cụ thể (mốc thời gian, đầu việc rõ ràng) cho dự án hoặc nhóm dự án phụ trách. ● Đảm bảo các thành viên trong nhóm tuân thủ đúng quy trình làm việc và tiêu chuẩn bàn giao đã được thiết lập. ● Theo dõi tình hình của các thành viên, chủ động nhận diện sớm rủi ro (chậm tiến độ, sai lệch kỳ vọng, phàn nàn từ khách hàng); khi có sự cố, phối hợp cùng quản lý dự án phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ và đề xuất biện pháp khắc phục, phòng ngừa tái diễn. ● Phân tích dữ liệu vận hành của nhóm để phát hiện điểm nghẽn giữa các bộ phận liên quan, chủ động đề xuất bỏ bớt những việc không tạo giá trị. 3. Quan hệ khách hàng ● Phân tích phong cách giao tiếp và mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng theo từng dự án để điều chỉnh cách tiếp cận phù hợp. ● Hướng dẫn các thành viên trong nhóm cách ứng xử với khách hàng, xử lý các tình huống cần báo cáo cấp trên, giữ thái độ bình tĩnh và định hướng giải pháp trong tình huống khó. 4. Đào tạo & phát triển đội ngũ ● Thiết kế các hoạt động đào tạo, huấn luyện và trực tiếp hướng dẫn từng thành viên qua các tình huống thực tế: đàm phán deadline, xử lý phàn nàn, giải thích nội dung kỹ thuật. ● Đánh giá năng lực từng thành viên để làm cơ sở phân công công việc; phối hợp với bộ phận nhân sự đề xuất phương án bố trí nhân sự phù hợp với từng dự án. ● Tham gia cùng cấp trên xây dựng mục tiêu cho nhóm/dự án phụ trách; truyền cảm hứng và lắng nghe để tháo gỡ khó khăn tâm lý cho từng thành viên. ● Chủ động tìm hiểu và đánh giá các công nghệ, công cụ mới (kể cả AI) có thể ứng dụng vào công việc của nhóm; tổ chức các buổi chia sẻ, workshop nội bộ để cả team cùng nâng cấp năng lực. ● Quan sát và phát hiện các thành viên có tiềm năng phát triển, đề xuất với cấp quản lý về lộ trình phát triển hoặc phương án bồi dưỡng phù hợp cho từng người
